$comment: Canonical, tool-agnostic source of truth for Agentry's extensions and how they group into plugins. Per-tool packaging (e.g. .claude-plugin/, .trae-plugin/) and derived skill references (a plugin's skillReferences embeds a copy of a canonical rule into a skill's references/) are GENERATED from this file by 'scripts/agentry.py generate', and 'scripts/agentry.py install' installs components into a tool's directories from here. Edit this file, not the generated artifacts.
name: agentry
description: A collection of reusable extensions for AI coding agents, grouped into plugins.

plugins.name: agentry-code-quality
plugins.description: Code review skill and a code-reviewer subagent that catch correctness, security, and maintainability issues and return prioritized, actionable feedback.

plugins.name: agentry-security
plugins.description: Security audit skill that runs a threat-driven review of code: maps the attack surface and trust boundaries, hunts vulnerability classes (injection, auth/authz flaws, SSRF, secrets, weak crypto, and more), rates findings by likelihood and impact, and reports exploit scenarios with concrete remediations.

plugins.name: agentry-git
plugins.description: Git workflow and Conventional Commits skills for branching, merging, rebasing, pull requests, releases, and well-formed commit messages.

plugins.name: agentry-authoring
plugins.description: Authoring skills for building AI agent extensions: create skills, subagents, rules, prompt templates, and plugins/marketplaces that follow open agent conventions.

plugins.name: agentry-docs
plugins.description: Documentation authoring skills for software projects, starting with creating and maintaining README files following standard conventions.
